items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: There was twelve of us fellas and eighteen girls in a line, the original Missouri Rockets from the Missouri Theatre in St. Louis, Missouri.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. After taking up the foundation of dancing and everything, the basics of all of it and singing, well then I worked at some of their leading nightclubs there such as the Coke Cabana and the Latin Quarters there, which at that time was two of their most popular nightclubs.
How about Robert Elton and the Missouri Rockets lead?

Oh, yes. That was quite a memorable time. I remember I worked as a course boy. There was twelve of us fellas and eighteen girls in a line, the original Missouri Rockets from the Missouri Theatre in St. Louis, Missouri. And we went from the St. Louis, Missouri, the Missouri Theatre to the Roxy Theatre in New York. Then I left them and went then as an individual singer and dancer.
